en.headline: MTR resumes Kwun Tong Line after trackside fire at Lam Tin
en.dek: A fire beside the tracks at Lam Tin station halted services between Kwun Tong and Tiu Keng Leng during the evening peak; the blaze has been extinguished and trains are returning to normal.
body: The MTR Corporation said a fire broke out beside the tracks at Lam Tin station on the Kwun Tong Line on Tuesday evening, prompting temporary service adjustments during the evening peak.

Services between Kwun Tong and Tiu Keng Leng were suspended while trains between Kwun Tong and Whampoa ran every four minutes. Lam Tin station was closed, and the operator arranged free shuttle buses between Kwun Tong, Lam Tin and Yau Tong.

Fire Services Department and MTR personnel extinguished the fire by about 6.30pm and completed safety checks. The MTR said services on the Kwun Tong Line began returning to normal from 6.36pm. No injuries were reported.
Passengers were advised to allow extra time and consider alternative routes or other transport while the situation stabilised. Additional staff were deployed at stations along the line to assist.

zh.headline: 藍田站路軌旁火警擔滅 觀塘綫服務逐步復常
zh.dek: 觀塘綫藍田站路軌旁傍晚發生火警，觀塘至調景嶺一度暫停，消防及港鐵人員已擔滅火種，列車服務於下午6時36分起逐步回復正常。
body: 港鐵公司表示，周二傍晚觀塘綫藍田站路軌旁發生火警，導致晚高峰期間列車服務需要調整。
觀塘站來往調景嶺站暫停服務，觀塘站來往黃埔站維持約每4分鐘一班；藍田站因無列車服務而關閉，港鐵安排免費接駁巴士往來觀塘、藍田及油塘站。
消防處及港鐵人員約於下午6時30分擔滅火種並完成安全檢查。港鐵指觀塘綫列車服務由下午6時36分起逐步回復正常，暫未有人受傷報告。
港鐵呼籲乘客預留額外時間，並考慮使用其他綫路或交通工具，沿綫車站已加派人手協助乘客。
